function: PPO agent at the satellite sets power allocation, common-rate split and public-rate order of an RSMA downlink to minimize average UoI under power and queue limits (pp. 8-9).
system: LEO satellite downlink at 20 GHz, 50 MHz sub-bandwidth: Nt=1, 2 or 4 antennas, K=2-6 single-antenna terrestrial devices, one-layer RSMA, no RIS (pp. 3, 11-12).
method: PPO actor-critic (two hidden layers, GAE, clipping), deep reinforcement learning inside a Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty framework, trained by trial and error with the simulated environment (pp. 8-10).
data_channel: Own simulator: LEO downlink at 600 km, 20 GHz, LoS path loss, i.i.d. shadowed-Rician fading at three shadowing levels; no 3GPP model or measurements (pp. 3, 10).
test_conditions: Same simulated setting for training and evaluation (1000 epochs of 200 slots); sweeps over SNR, fading level, antennas, K, V, Y; no unseen scenario (pp. 10-12).
baselines: Sampling policies AoI-optimal, MPE-optimal (Fig. 6, no learning); schemes UMPA-US-RSMA (uniform sampling), DDPG-SS-RSMA, no-sorting variant, UMPA-SS-NOMA, all with a learned agent (pp. 10-12).
metrics: Long-term average UoI and average power consumption, and their trade-off, versus SNR, number of devices, source states and V (pp. 11-12).
complexity: Network complexity O(2 Tup B (X0X1 + X1X2 + X2X3)) for the two PPO networks (p. 10); no runtime or FLOPs reported.
q1_support: p. 3: "adhere to the widely recognized shadowed-Rician fading channel"; custom simulator, no 3GPP TR 38.811 or 38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "we explore the influence of different fading levels of the shadowed-Rician channels"; sweeps of fading level, SNR, K and Nt only, with no unseen-scenario test or adaptation reported.
q3_support: p. 10: "our scheme is evaluated against four other state-of-the-art schemes"; all keep a learned agent (PPO, or "which derives the solution through the DDPG algorithm"); no non-learned baseline for the learned allocation.
q4_support: p. 10: "the network complexity can be defined as follows" with an explicit O(2 Tup B (X0 X1 + X1 X2 + X2 X3)) order for the PPO networks.
q5_support: p. 10: "The key simulation parameters are outlined in Tables I and II"; own simulation of shadowed-Rician channels, no code or data link, no public or measured dataset.
notes: Included, area 6: the learned PPO sets power, common rate and public-rate order of a satellite link, which the protocol counts as physical layer; the UoI metric and the CMDP threshold sampling policy are above PHY and not learned. q3 is borderline: AoI-optimal, MPE-optimal and uniform sampling (Fig. 6, Figs. 8-10) are non-learned only for the sampling policy, and every compared scheme keeps a PPO or DDPG agent, so the reviewer may count them. 3GPP TR 36.763 [34] is cited only for Doppler guard bands. Tables I-II and Figs. 6-10 read as page images.
